note: This is a formulation of Tutte's 1966 4-flow conjecture, not a separately posed sub-case. The general conjecture concerns all bridgeless graphs without a Petersen minor; the Petersen-minor-free condition is part of Tutte's original statement. The conjecture refines an earlier 5-flow conjecture posed by Tutte in 1954.
